case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You pointed to the alloy and material costs behind your quote, and we take that seriously. Option B answers it directly: through an index clause on the alloy surcharge, we carry the risk above the deadband, so the base price needs no risk premium.

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

On bar prices:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.79; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.77; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.84; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. It rests on the cost movements above and gives your house a fixed price over a longer contract term, with no index mechanics to administer. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

As you are our contact in inside sales, we would ask you to take Option A to the person who decides on pricing. For that person, in plain words: Option A gives Blankstahl Werdenfels a fixed unit price, a longer contract term and a reliable, long-term customer relationship between two family companies. It can be approved as it stands.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

We would be glad to settle this in a way that is fair to both family companies.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have verified the index changes for AS-14404 and PPI-C2431 you cited, which allows us to adjust our pricing accordingly. Building on your Option B, we agree to the 24-month contract, the 60-day payment term, and the AS-14404 index clause, offering a revised unit price of €5.60. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Please understand that we cannot provide a detailed cost breakdown, as our internal calculation structures are strictly confidential. 

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You asked for an index clause on the alloy, and all three of our options contain one: we carry the alloy risk above the deadband, so your base price no longer needs a risk premium.

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 81.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70740@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.89; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.87; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 3 %, base 2026-08); payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.94; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

As our contact in inside sales, you may need to take this to the person who decides. It brings a clear, steady basis for planning your capacity with a long-standing customer.

Could you please take Option A to that person and let us know the outcome? Thank you for your help in finding a fair solution.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
